definitions.meaning: as a verb, to make an improper or sexual approach to someone
a scheme or suggestion put forward for consideration

explanation.definitionFit: The word works both as a verb for making an indecent approach and as a noun for a suggested scheme.

definitions.meaning: a horse that bucks rises up on its hind legs
positioned behind, as in the hindmost part

explanation.definitionFit: A horse rising on its hind legs does this, and the same word describes the hindmost position.

definitions.meaning: a reserve of workers or talent ready to be called on, as in a typing reserve
the cue sport played on a table with six pockets

explanation.definitionFit: A reserve of available staff and the cue sport played with coloured balls share one name.

indicators.note: misappropriation suggests the letters are taken and put to a different, improper use, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone was called in to answer for embezzling rental income.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' looks like part of the fodder, but it is the link; 'misappropriation' works on the two words that follow it, so 'of' is fodder, not a joining word.
explanation.definitionFit: To be called for is to be summoned, as a doctor is when someone sends a message asking for one.

definitions.meaning: horse racing as a sport and institution is known by the name of its grass track

explanation.definitionFit: Horse racing is called after the grass track it is run on, and laying sods over soil uses the same word.

parts.note: frank means candid or open
an air is a look or appearance, as in an air of confidence

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims a candid warning to watch out.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation marks make 'Look out!' read as a warning, but 'out' alone is the definition: outdoors, under the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Being outside, not under a roof, is being outdoors in the fresh atmosphere.

clue.text: One searching for a place to stable a horse

parts.note: to stable an animal is to give it shelter, to lodge it
a hunter is a horse bred and trained for fox hunting

explanation.surface: Someone is looking for premises where a horse could be kept.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a single search for stabling; in fact 'One searching for a place' is the definition and the rest is wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone looking for a home to buy or rent is a person on the property hunt.

clue.text: Author known for his works in the tropics

definitions.text: Author known for his works in the tropics

parts.words: Author known for his works in the tropics
parts.note: the 'tropics' are not hot countries but the titles of two novels by an American writer, named after the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn

explanation.definitionFit: The American novelist wrote Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn, so his best-known works are set in the tropics by title.

indicators.note: start says the word 'to' goes at the beginning of the other piece

parts.note: re is Latin for about, concerning

explanation.surface: Someone rushed because they were on the point of beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to start' looks like a phrase for imminence; read it as RE (about) with TO at its start.
explanation.definitionFit: Rushed or dashed, the past tense of the verb meaning to move at speed.

parts.note: a struggle fought not with weapons but by trying to wear down the other side's courage and composure

explanation.definitionFit: A psychological contest in which each side tries to break the opponent's resolve and composure.

clue.text: A king on the way back as an emperor

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece on another is placed after it
back says the abbreviation for the way is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A monarch travelling home is in fact an emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns only the street abbreviation; in an across clue 'on' puts the A and king after it.
explanation.definitionFit: The title of the Russian emperor before 1917.

clue.text: Rapid cement breaking up in corner

indicators.note: breaking up suggests the letters are smashed apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: Quick-drying cement is cracking in the corner of a room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corner' is not an angle of a room but a tight spot, as in 'in a corner'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a corner means being in an awkward, difficult situation.

parts.note: a shooting-brake is an old British term for an estate car, but here it means something that stops a gun firing

explanation.walkthrough: A shooting-brake is a dated British name for an estate car (station wagon); the question mark invites a literal reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The locking lever on a gun prevents it being fired, acting as a brake on shooting.

clue.text: Powerful agency about to take on a member of the cast

indicators.note: taking on the next piece means it is attached after the first

parts.note: re is Latin for about, concerning
a performer in a play is one of its cast

explanation.surface: A powerful agency is on the point of signing up a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'agency' suggests a talent agency hiring actors; it is a force or means, here a nuclear one.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear plant core is a source of enormous energy, a powerful means of producing power.
A long gun and the verb meaning to ransack share one spelling.

clue.text: It may be checked for drink and meat around midnight

indicators.note: the drink and meat together go round the middle of night

parts.note: gin is a spirit drink
ham is cured pork
the middle letter of the word night

explanation.surface: A drink and some ham around midnight may be checked by someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'checked' looks like inspected, but it means patterned in squares.
explanation.definitionFit: The cotton fabric is typically woven in a checked pattern, as on tablecloths.

parts.note: G is a musical note

indicators.note: about suggests the letters of seen are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark observed regarding the components of DNA.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning'; it is the anagram signal working on SEEN to give ENES.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereditary units made of DNA that carry inherited traits.

parts.note: the 'flight' is a flight of stairs, not air travel; each step has an upright board as well as a tread

explanation.definitionFit: In a staircase the upright board between two treads is the vertical part of each step.

clue.text: The old way round to the squirrel's nest

indicators.note: round says the two pieces together are turned to read backwards

parts.note: ye is the old form of the, as in Ye Olde Tea Shoppe
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: An old route leads around to a squirrel's nest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' reverses both pieces together as one run, so the old article and the road abbreviation finish backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A squirrel builds a ball of twigs and leaves in a tree as its home.

parts.note: love means zero in tennis, and nil means zero

explanation.surface: A fondness for a deep blue colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'love' is the tennis score for zero, so NIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrub from which indigo dye is made, and the dark blue colour itself.

clue.text: Spirits obtainable in a channel vessel

indicators.note: obtainable in says the letters can be got from within the following words

explanation.surface: Liquor can be bought aboard a cross-Channel ferry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spirits' suggests duty-free alcohol on a Channel ferry; it means supernatural beings, found across chann-EL VES-sel.
explanation.definitionFit: Small mischievous supernatural beings of folklore are a kind of sprite.

clue.text: Charm of being in love in France

parts.note: en is French for in
amour is French for love

explanation.surface: The allure of romance in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in France' tells you to translate 'in love' into French: EN AMOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: To captivate someone so they become infatuated, a verb meaning to charm.

clue.text: Relief for one who's been had, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word is identified by how it is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: a gullible person who has been tricked, a dupe

explanation.surface: Comfort for a victim of a con.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relief' means aid or help given in distress.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid and assistance given in time of need is help or comfort.

clue.text: Foreign money invested in sugar crop and pepper

indicators.note: invested in puts the money inside the crop, as cash is put into a business

parts.note: sugar cane is a crop
the yen is the Japanese currency

explanation.surface: Overseas cash is put into a sugar plantation and pepper farming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invested' suggests finance; it means put inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot red powder made from dried chilli, a kind of capsicum spice.

indicators.note: wrongly suggests the letters of presume are arranged incorrectly

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly assumes something is at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: Of the greatest rank or degree, uppermost in authority.

clue.text: It should contain enough water to go round

definitions.text: It should contain enough water to go round

parts.words: It should contain enough water to go round
parts.note: reads like a host making sure there is a drink for everyone, but describes a defensive ditch filled with water encircling a castle

explanation.definitionFit: A water-filled ditch dug right round a castle for defence.

parts.note: reads as very bad-tempered, but also as being at the margins, near the borders, like something at its extremities

explanation.definitionFit: The word means nervy and tense, and also hints at being on the border or rim of something.

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the word is written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: Etna is the Sicilian volcano, whose head is literally hot

explanation.surface: A hot-tempered gambler upped the stakes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hothead' looks like an angry person; it is Mount Etna, a volcano, turned upwards by 'raised'.
explanation.definitionFit: The amount each poker player puts into the pot before the deal is the opening stake.

clue.text: Close after five as shopkeepers do

indicators.note: after says the word for close comes behind the numeral

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
end means close or finish

explanation.walkthrough: 'Close after five' reads as closing time; it is END placed after V (five).
explanation.definitionFit: Shopkeepers sell goods, and this verb means to sell.

clue.text: Wise advice to obtain skilled lawyer

definitions.meaning: an able barrister, counsel being a term for a courtroom advocate

explanation.definitionFit: Sound guidance is one sense; an able barrister is the other, counsel meaning a trial advocate.

definitions.meaning: British slang for pilfer or pinch
slang for prison, as is the British police station or cell

explanation.definitionFit: British slang for to pinch and for a prison or police cell, as jug also means.

parts.note: reads as relying on something, but literally means tallying devotions by fingering a string of beads

explanation.definitionFit: Catholics keep track of their prayers on the beads of a rosary.
